name: Option
description: Declarative option for Select, so choices can be written in markup instead of a data array. Renders nothing itself.
example:
<s-select v-model="channel" label="Channel">
  <s-option label="Direct" value="direct" />
  <s-option label="Marketplace" value="marketplace" />
  <s-option label="Sold out" value="none" disabled />
</s-select>
